setup_vasp_calc_mof: create VASP input files for MOF relaxation with atom and unit cell parameter optimization
setup_vasp_mof_and_ads: create VASP input files for MOF plus adsorbate relaxation with atom position optimization only
run_setup_vasp_calc_mof: run setup_vasp_calc_mof to generate VASP input files for a MOF structure from a CIF file
run_setup_vasp_mof_and_ads: run setup_vasp_mof_and_ads to generate VASP input files for a MOF with adsorbates from a CIF file
review_setup_vasp_functions: review the setup_vasp_calc_mof and setup_vasp_mof_and_ads functions for VASP calculator configuration and input file generation
